summary: Caledonia Mining Corp Plc filed a Form 6-K with a press release reporting a threshold crossing notification from BlackRock, Inc. BlackRock disclosed that on July 14, 2026 it held 6.18% of Caledonia's voting rights (5.00% via shares, 1.18% through financial instruments). This is routine AIM Rule disclosure of a major shareholding change, not a strategic transaction or special situation. No deal terms, board action, or advisor involvement. Equivalent to a US Schedule 13D/A filing. No further action required.
